title: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 — Rule 18, notice of meeting

content.note: Secondary reproduction of Rule 18, not Gazette-primary. The reproduced text addresses electronic notice, recipient email address, annual opportunity to register/update an email address, subject-line particulars, non-editable attachments/links, proof-of-sending records, transmission/failure allocation, and readability/retention of linked notice material. Confirm the current official Gazette text and amendments before final legal reliance.
